requirement_evidence.evidence: ActualK12IncrementalEngine (alias IncrementalEngine) maintains IncrementalState with owned detached copies of x_raw, x_norm, h1, p1, h2, p2, h3, logits, step_idx, recording_id, query_row_id, model_id, preprocessing_id, environment_profile_id, and supports QueryView. First call runs mode 'full'; reset() clears cache idempotently and forces next call to run full. Verified by test_c01_cold_start_and_query_view_support and test_c01_reset_is_idempotent_and_forces_full.

True stagewise partial recomputation (_forward_stages_partial) across all 5 stages per W4-019 schedule: Conv1 reuses 60/128 (recomputes 2 left + 66 right), Pool1 reuses 30/64 (recomputes 1 left + 33 right), Conv2 reuses 28/64 (recomputes 2 left + 34 right), Pool2 reuses 14/32 (recomputes 1 left + 17 right), Conv3 reuses 12/32 (recomputes 2 left + 18 right). Bitwise max difference across all 5 stages and logits is 0.0. Verified by test_c02_sequential_incremental_all_stages_bitwise_match.

Channel-major Flatten -> Linear128 -> ReLU -> Linear12 head is always completely evaluated without any GAP delta approximation. Logits match direct reference inference bitwise (max error 0.0) with 0 winner disagreements. Verified by test_c03_complete_mlp_head_evaluation.

Rigorous fail-closed preconditions enforced before incremental reuse: raw AND normalized overlap match (down to 1 ULP), shift==64, step_idx == last_step + 1, recording_id match, finite data, BN eval mode, and ReferenceOwner identity. Any violation safely triggers fallback to mode 'full'. Verified by test_c04_one_ulp_overlap_perturbation_triggers_fallback, test_c04_step_gap_repeat_and_backward_trigger_fallback, test_c04_recording_change_triggers_fallback, test_c04_invalid_shift_rejected.

Execution mode ('full' vs 'incremental'), stage_reused_columns, stage_recomputed_columns, reused_scalars (768) / recomputed_scalars (1280), logits, prediction, and exact stagewise MAC counts reported (Conv MACs: 532,224 vs 909,312 = 41.47% reduction; Total MACs: 795,904 vs 1,172,992 = 32.15% reduction; is_skipped_decision_reuse = False). Verified by test_c05_execution_reporting_stagewise_macs.

Strict anti-aliasing enforced: caller mutating input array or output dict cannot alter internal state. Invalid input (non-finite or wrong shape) raises ValueError and leaves cache state untouched. Reset is idempotent. Verified by test_c06_anti_aliasing_caller_mutations and test_c06_invalid_inputs_preserve_cache_state.

Empirical validation on all 2,422 validation windows (2,414 incremental passes, 99.67% coverage) and 5,053 test windows (5,034 incremental passes, 99.62% coverage): max error across all 5 stages and logits = 0.0, 0 winner disagreements. Documented in incremental_validation.json and verified by test_c07_validation_dataset_streaming_equivalence.

scientific_dispositions: Confirms H12/H13/H20: Incremental feature reuse is practically viable and delivers 100% bitwise exact equivalence (0.0 error, 0 winner disagreements) across continuous sensor streams.
Confirms H14/H22: Complete MLP head recomputation preserves theoretical soundness and speedup (~29% total MAC reduction) without unproved logit-delta shortcuts.
limitations: Incremental speedup applies strictly to continuous recording sessions with 50% overlap; isolated or non-contiguous windows require full forward passes.
Hardware latency reduction depends on CPU BLAS memory bandwidth and tensor slice assembly efficiency; full latency benchmark is deferred to M5 (W4-033).
